source.method: Actual pinned Quantizer class with genuine SDK headers/library versus actual production StockQuantizer probe. No reimplemented quantizer in fixtures, validator, or SDK adapter. Record complete source/header/compiler/executable closure before execution.

input_protocol.format: One whitespace-separated row per processed or bypassed frame; f32 decimals round-trip; integer fields decimal. Normal raw inactive input lanes must be positive zero.

events.1: Fresh actual constructor, all 12 notes enabled (4095); ignore loader fields. Apply row offset, then process/bypass.
events.2: Actual runtime onReset sets enabled notes to all true and refreshes ranges. Does not reset offset or playing state. UI Initialize parameter reset is separate host testing.
events.3: Same-rate rebuild/adopt with receiving mask equal to prior actual saved mask; receiving offset wins. SDK same instance retains processing state.
events.4: Actual dataFromJson enabledNotes array: -1 missing key, 0 empty, 1..14 actual boolean entries. First 12 entries come from mask bits; extra entries false. Missing tail entries retain prior values. Must call real production loader, not emulate partial loading in adapter.
events.5: Actual rotateNotes(delta); delta limited to [-12,12]. Positive one raises enabled pitch classes. Offset remains row value.
events.6: Same-rate rebuild/adopt with explicit receiving mask from field20. SDK actual full 12-boolean dataFromJson assignment. Receiving saved configuration and offset win; prior playing state retained.

input_protocol.order: Row offset is supplied before event; fresh/rebuilt receiving node uses it. Event applied before process/bypass. Configuration events still apply during bypass.

output_protocol.playing_valid: Derived lifetime bookkeeping, not a source DSP member: false on fresh constructor until first non-bypassed process, then true. Source playingNotes is uninitialized before first process: do not read it. Wire playing mask must be zero sentinel when invalid; this is not a claim that source bool storage is zero. Configuration events and bypass retain playing state/validity; rebuilt/adopted model retains it.
output_protocol.counts: All counts compared exactly. Connected output count=max(input_count,1), including bypass; disconnected count=0. Normal processing still computes actual playingNotes when output disconnected. Production processor owns actual consumer context; adapter may not overwrite counts to fake equivalence.
output_protocol.bypass: Actual source Module::processBypass routing: raw active pitch passthrough with no offset/quantization; width zero produces connected mono zero. Playing state freezes. Rust production bypass handles consumer context. Separate public Engine/tap tests prove connection-context delivery; direct class proof alone does not establish graph behavior.
output_protocol.padding: SDK inactive/disconnected raw output slots are excluded from numeric comparison, not sanitized in the oracle. Rust all inactive/disconnected slots must be positive zero. Normal input raw inactive slots are positive zero, so this declaration does not qualify poisoned inactive SDK input storage.
output_protocol.lights: NUM_LIGHTS=0. The keyboard uses the 12 actual playingNotes booleans, transported as optional playing mask. No fabricated light array or outputs-derived substitute.

normal_domain.input: Finite f32 raw CV, finite offset within [-1,1]. q=floor(f32(f32(input+offset)*24)) must be finite and -2147483640<=q<=2147483647 for each processed voice; normal bypass inputs obey the same conservative declared domain.
normal_domain.reason: Beyond the finite int conversion domain the C++ float-to-int conversion is undefined. Additionally q=-2147483648..-2147483641 makes eucDiv(q,24)*24 less than INT_MIN and overflows signed int. Lower safe mathematical q is ceil(INT_MIN/24)*24=-2147483640. Reachable f32 q endpoints exercised are +/-2147483520, from CV +/-89478480. At this bounded domain octave*12 plus ranges is safely in int32. Rotation excludes INT_MIN, whose negation in source would overflow.
normal_domain.rounding: IEEE-754 binary32 round-to-nearest-even, no fast-math reassociation; raw parameter is volts (display multiplies by 12). Negative Euclidean division and floor are source semantics, not truncation.

gates.reference: Every frame, no settling/discard/decimation: exact f32 bits for active output volts and offset; exact integers for count, mask, every cached range and all meaningful playing booleans. Zero absolute tolerance. Also apply independent counts, padding, lifecycle, range-membership, finite-state and hand-anchored outputs checks to both traces.
gates.safety: Rust only, explicitly no source numerical parity: non-bypassed nonfinite input becomes zero; finite out-of-domain floor uses defined saturating Rust i32 conversion with i64 Euclidean arithmetic, no arbitrary CV clamp. Non-bypassed active outputs/state must be finite. Bypass deliberately rawcopies active NaN/Inf/extreme values, with NaN-class equivalence and otherwise exact bits; padding remains positive zero. Recovery/reset anchors must pass.
gates.threshold_changes: All five declaration files frozen before first comparison. No fitted gates, removed cases, skipped frames, or post-hoc mirror expectations. Preserve failed reports/artifacts. Any discovered declaration error requires a separately versioned transparent erratum retaining original files/report.

coverage: Every one of 4096 masks loaded via actual 12-boolean JSON after a fresh all-enabled constructor; 24 half-semitone ranges at octave zero and minus one, each with interior, nominal boundary +/- adjacent f32, and actual f32 input-product transition pair, packed 16 voices per frame.

Selected singleton/complement/sparse/alternating/empty/full masks across seven raw f32 offsets and four additional octaves; domain extremes; all widths 0..16 and actual disconnected/reconnected consumers.
Hand C/D delayed scale-gap thresholds, octave-negative boundaries, singleton C ties and binary offset anchors; no generic expected-output quantizer implementation.

Playing union replacement/duplicate notes/shrink-regrow, missing/empty/short/full/long boolean JSON arrays, both rotation directions/composition, runtime reset, same-mask and receiving-mask adoption, fresh and established bypass, events while bypassed and recovery.
Same independent matrix at 44100/48000/96000 Hz; stateless quantization requires no artificial settling loops. All generated frames observed.
scope_limits: Not a full Rack engine, audio device, native visual, hardware, or all-host parity claim; public graph consumers/taps, serialization/session undo, Initialize parameter reset and shared UI panels require separate host tests.

Randomize has source independent Bernoulli note selection. All resulting masks are numerically covered, but SDK RNG sequence equivalence is not claimed. Host randomize updates saved mask/cache and undo separately.
Only source boolean-array JSON load shapes are qualified; malformed nonboolean JSON values are outside this frozen matrix and may need separate import tests.

Raw inactive poisoned input and uninitialized source playing storage are not source-qualified; public host padding and optional telemetry are explicit contracts. Existing legacy quantizer behavior is outside this new-kind proof.
